recipes.name: Banana Pudding Pizza inspired by Doug
instructions: For the Banana Pudding Pizza

In a bowl combine cornstarch with plain white sugar and whisk to combine. To the same bowl add whole milk and whisk until everything is incorporated. - 3 tbsp cornstarch - ¾ cup plain white sugar - 2 ½ cups whole milk
Add mixture to a pot and cook over a medium low heat stirring constantly.

When mixture is hot, remove ¼ of a cup and SLOWLY combine that with beaten egg yolks in a separate bowl. Once that is combined, SLOWLY add that mixture back to the pot and whisk until the mixture has thickened and coats the back of a spoon. - 3 beaten egg yolks

Remove from heat and place in a separate bowl. Add butter and vanilla paste. Whisk to combine. Let cool for about 30 minutes before covering with plastic wrap, pressing directly onto the surface of the pudding, and placing in the fridge until it sets. - 1 tbsp butter - 2 tbsp vanilla paste
Preheat your oven to 500°F.
Make your pizza dough, and top with sauce, mozzarella cheese, and pepperoni.
Cook for about 10 minutes or until crust is golden brown, and let sit to cool for about 5 minutes.
Remove pudding from fridge. Slice up some bananas and add to your pudding mixture. Stir to combine and then add to the top of the pizza. - Bananas
Serve and enjoy!
For the Swedish Pizza
Preheat your oven to 500°F.

Make your pizza dough, and top with sauce, mozzarella cheese, sliced banana, a handful of peanuts, some slices of ham and a generous sprinkling of curry powder. - Bananas - Peanuts - Ham - Curry powder
Cook until crust is golden brown.
Serve and enjoy!
For the Plantain Pizza

In a food processor, add plantains along with baking soda, some italian seasoning, olive oil, and some salt. Blend into a paste. - 2 Plantains - ¼ tsp baking soda - Italian seasoning - 2 tbsp olive oil - Salt
Add parchment paper to a baking sheet, and cover lightly with oil. Put plantain mixture on top of parchment paper in a small circle the size of a small pizza.
Bake in an oven at 375°F for about 12 minutes until it comes out golden brown and place on a cooling rack to let cool.
Add it to a well-oiled baking sheet and top with sauce, mozzarella cheese, and parmesan cheese. - Mozzarella - Parmesan cheese grated
Place back in the oven and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve and enjoy!
